series_label: Maternal mortality ratio (modeled estimate, per 100,000 live births)
source_or_custodian: World Development Indicators (WB_WDI); estimates by the Maternal Mortality Estimation Inter-Agency Group (WHO, UNICEF, UNFPA, World Bank Group, UNDESA/Population Division)
status_or_notes: Latest data year is 2023, so 2024 and 2025 are not available (24 of 26 requested years returned). Modeled estimates. The server notes the methodology differs from earlier estimates, so data should not be compared historically with older vintages. Ratios are generally of unknown reliability and cannot be assumed to be exact. SDG indicator 3.1.1.
definition: Number of women who die from pregnancy-related causes while pregnant or within 42 days of pregnancy termination per 100,000 live births. Estimated with a regression model using the proportion of maternal deaths among non-AIDS deaths in women ages 15-49, fertility, birth attendants, and GDP (PPP).
